title: 有成CRM MCP 对接配置
description: 连接您的有成CRM，用于查询和写入客户等业务对象数据、处理审批流程、检索部门与人员信息。API Key 仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传云端。
description_en: Connect your YCRM workspace to read and write business object data (e.g. customers), process approvals, and browse departments and users. Your API Key is stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only.

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: 登录有成CRM，在应用内点击操作即可自助生成
fields.placeholder_en: Log in to YCRM and generate it yourself in a few clicks
fields.description: 身份认证密钥，可在有成CRM应用内自助生成，以 X-Api-Key 请求头发送给有成CRM MCP 服务，用于识别您的企业身份。
fields.description_en: Authentication key that you can generate yourself in the YCRM app. It is sent as the X-Api-Key header to the YCRM MCP service to identify your account.
